'''Bhotur''' was a male [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] and a prominent leader of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. He and the other White Maw leaders gathered in secret to discuss further plans, but were ambushed by the Sith Empire and killed.<ref name="BTM" />
